title: Wunderlich's original 98.6F figure vs its 1992 recalculation

source.name: A Critical Appraisal of 98.6 Degrees F (Mackowiak, Wasserman & Levine, JAMA 1992)
source.publisher: JAMA (Journal of the American Medical Association)

notes: Carl Wunderlich's 1868 compilation (from roughly 25,000 patients) produced the 98.6F figure. A 1992 JAMA reanalysis of his surviving thermometers found they ran hot/were miscalibrated, estimating his true population mean was closer to 98.2F.
